name: Central Nervous System Malformation

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Neuroimaging-based Diagnostic Criteria for CNS Malformations

criteria.description: Identification of structural brain abnormalities on MRI or CT
Presence of neurological deficits consistent with CNS malformation
Detection of pathogenic variants associated with CNS malformations

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic CNS structural abnormalities on neuroimaging plus compatible neurological signs
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not mandatory.

pathognomonic.notes: Complete or partial absence of corpus callosum

common.notes: Delayed acquisition of motor and cognitive milestones
Accumulation of cerebrospinal fluid in ventricles

occasional.symptomName: Visual impairment due to optic nerve hypoplasia
occasional.notes: Reduced visual acuity related to optic nerve underdevelopment
searchTerms: poor vision from small optic nerves
optic nerve underdevelopment causing vision loss
vision problems due to optic nerve issues

occasional.notes: Characteristic facial features associated with some malformations

rare.symptomName: Endocrine dysfunction due to hypothalamic-pituitary axis malformation
rare.notes: Hormonal imbalances secondary to structural defects
searchTerms: hormone problems from brain gland malformation

rare.notes: Hearing impairment related to CNS anomalies
Near complete absence of cerebral hemispheres

laboratory: CSF analysis typically normal unless secondary complications
Endocrine hormone panels may reveal pituitary dysfunction
imaging: MRI showing structural brain malformations (e.g., agenesis of corpus callosum, holoprosencephaly)
CT scan may reveal ventricular enlargement or cortical abnormalities
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes such as SHH, ZIC2, or L1CAM
Chromosomal abnormalities detected by karyotyping or microarray
other: Neurodevelopmental assessment revealing cognitive and motor deficits

distinguishingFeatures: Primary ventricular enlargement without cortical malformation
Diffuse brain dysfunction without structural anomalies on imaging
Presence of metabolic abnormalities in laboratory testing

references: Orphanet: Central Nervous System Malformations - ORPHA:98044
Barkovich AJ et al. Pediatric Neuroimaging. 6th Edition. 2012.
Dobyns WB et al. Malformations of the brain: clinical and genetic aspects. Neurology. 2012.
